scope: Limited-test community observations about Claude Opus 5.6

cases.title: The Tea Ride
cases.takeaway: Look for how a Three.js short sustains one scene for 82 seconds.
cases.source_notes: The post shows a rendered animation and says it used no external assets.

cases.title: Phoenix above the clouds
cases.takeaway: Inspect how a code-driven short stages a large moving subject.
cases.source_notes: The post presents a phoenix animation and describes the output as pure code.

cases.title: Fox SVG loop comparison
cases.takeaway: Compare motion and loop transitions side by side.
cases.source_notes: The poster says both versions received the same prompt. The clip is one comparison.

cases.title: Code-synthesized singing
cases.takeaway: Listen for how synthesized vocals and visuals work together.
cases.source_notes: The poster describes both the audio and visuals as code-generated and reports no text-to-speech.

cases.title: Python observatory animation
cases.takeaway: Use this as an example of rendering an animation frame by frame in Python.
cases.source_notes: The posting account says Python drew every frame and reports no separate image or video model.

cases.title: Calligraphy machine
cases.takeaway: Look for ink diffusion and focus when assessing the result.
cases.source_notes: The poster describes a one-pass result and calls out missing ink diffusion and focus problems.

cases.title: Exploded mechanical watch
cases.takeaway: Inspect how the animation shows parts separating and reassembling.
cases.source_notes: The clip shows gears, a spring mechanism, and the disassembly and reassembly sequence.

cases.title: Voxel sandbox in one HTML file
cases.takeaway: Inspect lighting and movement in a voxel sandbox demo.
cases.source_notes: The post describes a single HTML file with multiple game modes. The evidence here is a recording.

cases.title: Three.js first-person game
cases.takeaway: Review the first-person movement and level presentation in the footage.
cases.source_notes: The posting account reports using Three.js and gives three hours as the build time. Playability remains unverified.

cases.title: Tower defense trailer
cases.takeaway: Use the trailer to inspect the game’s visual direction.
cases.source_notes: The poster describes a playable prototype from one 20-word prompt. The linked evidence is a trailer.
